ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized representatives against the Egyptian Terrorist Entities List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC Specifically Designated Nationals (SDN) list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK OFSI Sanctions List, and Interpol notices. Politically Exposed Persons (domestic and foreign) require enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, and continuous transaction monitoring. Egypt is a FATF-monitored jurisdiction, therefore additional EDD triggers apply for high-risk sectors including Class III medical device export activities.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Corporate Electronic Filing Portal and Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Arabic is the official language of the commercial register. Every company name must be rendered in Arabic script; a transliterated Latin version may be registered as a trading name provided the Arabic form remains the legal name for liability purposes. The name must not conflict with existing marks or violate Law No. 82 of 2002 on Intellectual Property Rights.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, an administrative appeal may be filed in writing with GAFI's Complaints and Grievances Committee within 30 days of the rejection notification. The Committee must issue a reasoned resolution within 15 business days. If the rejection is affirmed, the applicant may file an annulment suit before the Cairo Administrative Court within 60 days of notification of the final administrative decision. A new name reservation may be filed simultaneously without prejudice to the pending appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a Class III medical device manufacturer (drug-eluting coronary stents), a virtual office is not permissible. A physical commercial/industrial registered office in Egypt and a licensed manufacturing plant are mandatory, together with a resident general manager or authorized local representative. GAFI and the Egyptian Drug Authority will reject a purely virtual address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — approximately 85% probability of an unannounced GAFI or Egyptian Drug Authority physical inspection within 12 months after licensing, with at least one mandatory on-site audit during the first license validity cycle.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 4 of 2023 and Law No. 5 of 2024; Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976; Executive Regulations of the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Establishment Department, via the Ahlan Egypt one-stop-shop portal, and the local Commercial Registry office.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Aqd al-Ta'sis wa Nizam al-Sharika) submitted in electronic form through GAFI for issuance of the incorporation certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed for LLCs; however, the entire subscribed capital must be fully paid and deposited in an Egyptian bank account opened by GAFI before incorporation. For foreign shareholders, the deposit is made through the CBE gold-room procedure and must be held blocked to permit conversion and remittance evidence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION. RESOLVED: (1) the subscribed shares in the capital table of the approved Articles are fully accepted and allotted to the founding members; (2) the registered office at the address stated in the incorporation file is ratified; (3) the founding director and general manager are appointed to manage the entity until the first shareholders' meeting; (4) a corporate bank account shall be opened and authorized signatories designated; (5) the corporate seal shall be adopted; and (6) the general manager is authorized to complete commercial registration, tax registration, social insurance, and industrial licensing formalities. This resolution is immediately effective.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Investment Scope Pre-Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Ahlan Egypt One-Stop-Shop (online investment services window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the GAFI portal, select LLC incorporation, reserve the proposed corporate name, and verify permissibility of the object clause for medical device manufacturing under ISIC 3250. Upload the required identity and address documents and pay the reservation fee. GAFI will issue the name reservation certificate and confirm journal publication eligibility.
required_dossiers: Reservation form signed by all founders
Passport or national ID copies of founding members
Proposed company name and five alternate names
Draft object clause describing stent manufacturing activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or the object clause is queried, refile within five working days using the GAFI grievance form, submitting a revised name list or an amended object clause aligned with the Industrial Licensing Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Legalization of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office (Shahr Al-Tawqee) under the Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name approval, prepare the Arabic-language Articles of Association containing the corporate name, object clause, capital structure, registered office, and governance provisions. Arrange personal appearance of all founders before the notary to sign each page; pay the notarization stamp duty and obtain the official notarized Arabic original and an Arabic/English certified translation where foreign documents are used.
required_dossiers: GAFI name reservation certificate
Draft Articles of Association and Memorandum
Passport or national ID copies of each founder
Signed minutes of the constituent assembly accepting the capital
Power of attorney if any founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a substantive query, correct the drafting defect within 10 working days and re-present the amended pages; a second notarization will be scheduled for the corrected signatures without re-initiation of GAFI review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Paid-Up Share Capital in Egyptian Bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Bank licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional capital subscription account in the company name at a CBE-licensed bank. Deposit the full subscribed capital specified in the Articles. Obtain a bank certificate of deposit stating the account number, capital amount, currency, and date. For foreign currency conversion, the deposit must pass through the CBE gold-room procedure and be tagged with the company incorporation file number.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Name reservation certificate
Founding members' identity documents
CBE foreign currency application form if applicable
Bank account opening form and AML/KYC declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the capital source or currency regulation, provide bank statements and transaction provenance declarations; if the account remains blocked, appeal to the CBE banking supervision department to release the funds for incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Application and Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Companies Establishment Department via Ahlan Egypt platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation dossier through the GAFI portal together with mandatory annexes. GAFI conducts a statutory compliance review against Law 159/1981 as amended, confirms capital deposit, verifies the legal object and board appointments, and issues the electronic incorporation certificate together with the initial commercial registration decision. Payment of official fees is made online after approval.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association and Memorandum
Bank certificate of capital deposit
Founders' consent minutes and first board resolution
Lease agreement or notarized proof of registered office address
Name reservation certificate
Power of attorney for the incorporator if any
GAFI online filing fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query on governance clauses, lease validity, or shareholder compliance, respond within 15 working days through the portal; an oral hearing before the GAFI grievance committee may be requested if the objection is substantive. Failure to cure timely causes the application to lapse and requires re-filing with supplementary documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry, Tax Card, and Chamber of Commerce Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office at the competent district; co-ordinated by GAFI One-Stop-Shop with the Egyptian Tax Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation certificate issuance, register the company in the Commercial Registry and collect the establishment license. Apply for a tax card from the Egyptian Tax Authority, register for corporate income tax, VAT and withholding tax, and file the acquisition form. Register employees and the manager with the Social Insurance Authority within fourteen days of commencement.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate
Notarized Articles of Association
Bank certificate of capital deposit
Lease agreement with utility proof
Board resolution appointing the manager
Passport photographs and identity copies of the manager and authorized signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry queries the registered office or signatory authority, submit the GAFI-certified corrected board resolution and address lease; appeal any tax classification dispute to the Egyptian Tax Authority internal committee within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication and Final Post-Registration Corporate Seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Publication department of the Official Commercial Bulletin (Al-Kitab Al-Tijari) and GAFI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the incorporation notice to be published in the official commercial journal as required by law, including company name, capital, registry number, address, and representatives. After publication, obtain a certified copy from GAFI, create the corporate seal at a licensed engraver, and submit the seal imprint to tax and commercial registry to complete the formation stage.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate copy
Commercial Registry declaration
Tax card or tax registration intake document
Official publication fee receipt
Corporate seal imprint certificate application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the gazette publication contains a clerical error, request a corrected republication under GAFI cover within 10 working days; objections to the publication text are examined by the publication authority and amended with the registry's consent.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) – Medical Devices Sector, in coordination with the Industrial Development Authority (IDA) for factory licensing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Establishment Manufacturing License for Class III Medical Devices and Drug-Eluting Coronary Stents

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Environmental Impact Assessment and Industrial Pollution Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Full EIA Report required: the stent manufacturing facility involves laser micro-machining, solvent degreasing, chemical surface treatment, and controlled waste generation, mandating a scoping report and full environmental impact assessment before construction and operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with Law 48/1982 and Ministerial Decree 92/2013 for industrial effluents; air emissions of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and particulates must remain below the thresholds of Environmental Protection Law 4/1994 as amended by Law 9/2009; hazardous solvent waste, acid/alkaline baths, and resin waste must be managed and tracked through the hazardous waste manifests required by Ministerial Decree 276/2000.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety and Civil Defense Certificate from the General Administration of Civil Defense (Ministry of Interior) covering torch suppression systems, emergency exits, and hazardous material storage; structural load inspection and safety clearance approved by the local administrative/governor's licensing committee; occupational safety and health audit following the Ministry of Manpower regulations on laser and chemical exposure, ventilation monitoring, and worker medical surveillance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), the unified national tax administration under the Ministry of Finance; official e-portals: eta.gov.eg for unified tax registration and filing, einvoicing.eta.gov.eg for e-invoicing integration, and nafiza.gov.eg for the NAFIZA customs single window. Customs duty and export declaration functions are executed by the Egyptian Customs Authority within the same Ministry of Finance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step-wise procedure for a foreign parent establishing an Egyptian LLC: (1) incorporate the LLC through the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) One-Stop-Shop under Investment Law 72/2017, Arabic-translating and notarizing the foreign parent's constitutional documents, executing the LLC Articles of Association, and obtaining the Commercial Registry extract; (2) within 30 days of commercial registration, file with the territorially competent ETA office the commercial registry extract, certified Articles of Association, board of managers resolution appointing the statutory tax representative, proof of Egyptian head-office premises, opening bank certificate, and power of attorney; (3) obtain the ETA statutory Tax Card and the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN), which serves for corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax and e-invoicing; (4) register for VAT under Law 67/2016 if annual taxable turnover meets the statutory threshold or immediately if the LLC intends to claim export zero-rating; (5) activate the ETA e-invoicing account and obtain PKI credentials; and (6) complete payroll, social insurance and any sectoral registrations (Egyptian Drug Authority licensing for Class III medical device manufacture).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the Egyptian LLC is an opaque, Egypt-resident taxpayer (incorporated under Egyptian law) taxed under Income Tax Law 91/2005 at the standard corporate income tax rate of 22.5% on worldwide taxable profits, with no pass-through or transparent classification available. Territorial scope applies only to foreign-company branches or permanent establishments, which are taxed exclusively on Egypt-source income. The manufacturing project is not automatically within the Tax_Exempt_Zone category; free-zone status or Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) incentives are elective, project-specific regimes under Investment Law 72/2017 and must be secured at establishment stage.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egyptian law does not provide a check-the-box or partnership-classification election for LLCs; entity-level taxation is mandatory. Available statutory elections include: (i) adoption of a non-calendar fiscal year with ETA approval; (ii) investment cost deduction and accelerated depreciation on qualifying new manufacturing assets under Law 91/2005 and Investment Law 72/2017; (iii) free-zone or SCZone election for qualifying export-oriented production projects; and (iv) tax dispute reconciliation and settlement incentives under Law 30/2023. For U.S. federal purposes only, the foreign parent may file a check-the-box election under U.S. Treas. Reg. Sec. 301.7701-3 treating the Egyptian LLC as disregarded, but such election has no effect on Egyptian taxation and hybrid mismatch exposure should be assessed under BEPS Action 2.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Egyptian VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 and Executive Regulation No. 66 of 2016, as amended; supplemented by stamp duty (Law 111/1980) and customs duty under the Unified Customs Law No. 207 of 2020.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration applies where annual taxable turnover exceeds EGP 500,000 on supplies of goods or EGP 150,000 on supplies of services (Article 26, VAT Law 67/2016); importers and exporters claiming zero-rating must register regardless of turnover, and voluntary registration is permitted for lower-turnover persons.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: ETA Electronic Invoicing (E-Invoice) and Electronic Receipts (E-Receipt) are mandatory under Ministerial Decrees 623/2020 and 364/2022. Taxpayers integrated by rollout wave must connect their ERP/accounting systems to the ETA integration API using OAuth2.0 authentication and the ETA XML/JSON schema with PKI digital signatures. Each invoice is submitted to the ETA clearance engine, which returns a cryptographic validation token (hash/UUID) and a Quick-Response code before the invoice is issued to the counterparty. The model operates as a pre-clearance and validation mechanism rather than a live fiscal cash-register stamp; invoices lacking ETA codes are fiscally non-compliant and input VAT deduction is denied. Export invoices must cross-reference the NAFIZA customs export declaration. Non-compliance attracts administrative fines of EGP 10,000 to EGP 50,000 per invoice under Article 36 of VAT Law 67/2016, in addition to disallowance of input VAT.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 18 of VAT Law 67/2016, exports of goods and services supplied to non-residents and wholly consumed abroad are chargeable at 0% VAT. To qualify for the coronary drug-eluting stent export: (i) the Egyptian LLC must effect a genuine sale to a foreign purchaser under a commercial contract financed by Letter of Credit or SWIFT wire; (ii) the goods must physically depart Egyptian customs territory, evidenced by the NAFIZA electronic export declaration; (iii) title and risk must pass to the foreign buyer outside Egypt under an export Incoterms rule; (iv) the shipment must leave within the applicable customs/VAT export deadline; (v) the Class III medical device shipment must carry a valid Egyptian Drug Authority export permit, free-sale certificate and ISO 13485/CE conformity documentation; and (vi) export proceeds must be collected through licensed Egyptian bank channels. Attributable input VAT on polymer tubing, laser micro-machining services, component raw materials, packaging and freight is creditable and refundable to the exporter through the ETA refund procedure.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Automated Customs Export Declaration filed via NAFIZA single window and released by the Egyptian Customs Authority
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export and delivery outside Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a licensed Egyptian bank evidencing collection of foreign-currency export proceeds
Commercial export invoice stating HS Code 9021 classification and zero-rating basis
Certificate of Origin issued by the Federation of Egyptian Chambers of Commerce
Egyptian Drug Authority export permit and free-sale certificate for the Class III coronary drug-eluting stent
ISO 13485, CE marking and UDI technical file retained for ETA and customs inspection
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is a priority ETA and customs audit focus. The ETA fuses NAFIZA departure records, e-invoice clearance codes, cargo manifests and bank inward-remittance data to verify that zero-rated exports are real, timely and fully repatriated. Failure to prove physical export or to repatriate export proceeds within the applicable Central Bank of Egypt deadline (generally 180 days) recharacterizes the supply as domestic taxable output VAT, assessed with statutory late-payment interest, refund clawback and per-invoice fines. Knowingly issuing forged, false or inflated export documentation constitutes tax evasion under Article 37 of VAT Law 67/2016, punishable by imprisonment of three to five years and/or fines of EGP 20,000 to EGP 50,000 in addition to the evaded tax, and may also trigger fraud penalties under Income Tax Law 91/2005. Consequences include retrospective clawback of refunded input VAT with interest, suspension or cancellation of VAT and e-invoicing registrations, revocation of NAFIZA and export privileges, criminal referral, and reopening of assessments within the statutory limitation period, ordinarily up to five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), operating under Egyptian Foreign Exchange Law No. 194 of 1993 as amended; ancillary authority is exercised by the General Authority for Foreign Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) for inbound capital and by the Egyptian Tax Authority for profit remittance clearance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Since March 2024, Egypt maintains a unified managed-float exchange rate. Current-account convertibility is broadly available for trade, permitted services, royalties, and current remittances through CBE-licensed authorized banks at the interbank market rate. Capital-account convertibility remains controlled: foreign direct investment in an Egyptian LLC must be registered with GAFI, and outward remittances of dividends, branch profits, shareholder loans, and liquidation proceeds require audited financial statements, tax clearance, distributable-reserve evidence, and a documented source of the original EGP or foreign-currency funds. Profit-repatriation queues and dedicated FX allocation channels were removed in the 2024 unification; practical delays are liquidity-driven and can be mitigated by maintaining full commercial documentation and prompt tax filings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE supervisory requirements, 100% of export proceeds for goods such as coronary drug-eluting stents and related medical-device components must be credited to an account maintained with an authorized bank in Egypt within the CBE-prescribed statutory period, generally 60 days from the date of export loading or bill of lading, unless a documented extended payment term or free-zone exemption is approved by the authorized bank. Under the current unified float there is no mandatory conversion ratio into EGP; export proceeds may be retained in a foreign-currency account with an authorized bank, but all receipts must be repatriated through the formal banking channel and traceable to the underlying customs export declaration.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for treasury-critical clearing. Offshore digital EMIs are not licensed by the CBE, have no access to the Egyptian RTGS/Meeza clearing systems, cannot issue Egyptian EGP IBANs, and cannot hold or clear export proceeds requiring statutory repatriation. Their permissible use is limited to ancillary offshore cards and payment-wallet consolidation outside Egypt. A CBE-licensed local fintech may be used as a front-end payment interface only if it is backed by an authorized clearing bank and does not handle export-proceeds surrender or commercial L/C operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for a high-risk Class III medical-device manufacturer. At least one authorized signatory or a properly appointed director/attorney-in-fact must attend a face-to-face onboarding interview at the chosen bank branch. Remote video verification is supplementary and cannot replace the interview where regulatory risk is elevated. Ultimate beneficial owners holding 25% or more are subject to individual identification; when a foreign parent is a UBO, original notarized and apostilled corporate documents, board resolutions, passport copies, and certified Arabic translations are mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or shareholder located in a high-risk or non-cooperative jurisdiction, or politically exposed person status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Register of beneficial owners, PEP declarations, five-year business and employment history, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements, professional references, sanctions and adverse-media screening reports, passport copies, and a board resolution documenting the group governance framework.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Class III implantable-medical-device or drug-eluting-stent production categorized as healthcare manufacturing with product-liability exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Egyptian Drug Authority medical-device registration, Ministry of Health import/export permits, ISO 13485 certificate, CE or FDA conformity documentation, current Good Manufacturing Practice evidence, sterilization and lot-traceability records, and an external quality-risk assessment report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large expected cross-border flows from foreign parent or related suppliers without clear commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreements, OEM or toll-manufacturing contracts, proforma invoices, bills of lading, Egyptian customs declarations, technical specifications, transfer-pricing report aligned with Egyptian Tax Law, and audited financial statements showing matching trade receivables and payables.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity injection structured as a capital increase or shareholder loan with unexplained source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment license or no-objection certificate, board minutes, share-subscription agreement, SWIFT MT103 chain showing source and intermediate accounts, Commercial Registry capital registration, and an independent source-of-funds report for amounts above USD 1 million.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue concentration in export markets involving pharmacies, ministries, or state-owned healthcare distributors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Validated customer or tender contracts, end-customer list, documented commission agreements, export distribution agreements, anti-bribery and anti-corruption compliance program, enhanced due diligence on distributors, and country-specific product registration where applicable.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: After GAFI approval and Commercial Registry capital registration, the non-resident shareholder transfers equity through SWIFT MT103 to the LLC’s foreign-currency capital account at a CBE-authorized bank. The beneficiary payment reference must include the official company name, GAFI investment file number or no-objection certificate, Commercial Registry number, tax card number, and the Balance-of-Payments purpose code for equity injection / foreign direct investment. The authorized bank verifies the transaction through sanctions screening, source-of-funds confirmation, and underlying GAFI documents; cash deposits in Egypt require a customs/currency declaration if applicable. Funds from undisclosed third-party pooling accounts or unrelated group entities should be avoided; all upstream transfers should be supported by a chain-of-title document from the ultimate beneficial owner and a shareholder resolution approving the capitalization.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are executed through SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for open-account supplier payments and through SWIFT MT700/MT707 for irrevocable commercial letters of credit issued by an Egyptian authorized bank. For import of raw materials, machinery, and packaging, the LLC must submit the proforma invoice, purchase contract, customs import declaration, and any required conformity or quality certificates. Bank-to-bank settlement is cleared via correspondent banking rails: USD through Fedwire/CHIPS, EUR through TARGET2, and minor currencies through agent banks. The authorized bank verifies that each foreign-currency debit is supported by a legitimate current-account transaction; for L/C issuance, the applicant must provide the full underlying commercial documentation and an FX facility agreement if the bank requires prepayment coverage.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forwards with a CBE-authorized bank, restricted to documented current-account exposures such as import invoices, export receivables, equipment lease payments, and royalty obligations.
Onshore FX swaps between EGP and USD or EUR with a licensed authorized bank, used to align the timing of real import payments and export collections without creating speculative open FX positions.

Cross-currency swaps in respect of approved foreign-currency debt or project financing, provided the notional and interest flows match the LLC’s actual debt-service schedule and are supported by executed facility documents.

Offshore NDFs are not permissible as an onshore Egyptian banking transaction; the EGP non-deliverable market may be used only by the non-resident parent or treasury center to hedge consolidated group EGP exposure outside Egypt and without any onshore settlement or CBE registration.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% imposed on the net worldwide income of resident Egyptian LLCs under Law No. 91 of 2005, Article 7 as amended; the separate 40.55% rate for upstream petroleum activities does not apply to medical-device manufacturing; a foreign corporation with a permanent establishment in Egypt pays the same 22.5% on Egyptian-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment Law No. 72/2017 and the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) regime grant: (i) 30% deduction of eligible investment cost in the general zone, 40% in new industrial governorates, and 50% in less-developed border and SCZone areas, available over up to 10 years; (ii) qualifying SCZone industrial projects may enjoy a 0% income tax holiday for up to 5 years; (iii) Free-Zone export entities are exempt on export profits, with local-sale profits taxed at 22.5%; (iv) accelerated depreciation for GMP and ISO-certified stent manufacturing lines and science-based R&D deductions. Combined incentive geometry places the effective rate near 10% to 15%, and at or near 0% during the SCZone holiday window.
